Title: Monster Truck Racing Game Truck Race

Drive powerful 4x4 monster trucks across extreme tracks, perform impossible stunts, and explore dangerous offroad environments in this action-packed monster truck driving simulator game. If you love offroad racing games, truck stunt games, or realistic driving simulators, then this game is made just for you. Easy steering, realistic physics, and responsive handling for the best driving experience.
